comparison.objective: Build two stacked, free-standing trilithons from six slender blocks.
comparison.physical_skill: Millimeter-precision stacking, balance control, gentle release, and cumulative-error management.
comparison.success_condition: Two-level 18 cm structure assembled and released, with staged partial credit and one second of stability.
comparison.reason: Precision free-standing construction is different from tool-mediated adjustment, lock retention, and dynamic stop commissioning.
